settings.heading: One surface. The whole desk makes sense.
settings.body: A desk mat is the quietest upgrade you can make. It gives the keyboard a softer floor, the mouse an even run, and everything else a boundary to sit inside — so the desk reads as one considered surface instead of scattered hardware.

settings.title: A quieter desk
settings.body: The mat takes the hard edge off key chatter and mouse clicks — the difference shows up on long calls and late sessions.

settings.title: Edge-to-edge tracking
settings.body: An even surface means the cursor behaves the same at the far corner as it does in the middle. No dead patches, no hunting.

settings.title: One defined surface
settings.body: Keyboard, mouse, phone, notebook. Everything lands inside one boundary instead of drifting across the desk.

settings.title: Kinder to the desk
settings.body: A layer between hardware and the desktop keeps scuffs, scratches and coffee rings off the surface underneath.

settings.title: Wipes clean
settings.body: Dust, crumbs and the occasional spill come off with a damp cloth. No special treatment required.

settings.title: Looks considered
settings.body: The fastest way to make a desk look finished rather than assembled — one rectangle pulling the setup together.

settings.heading: Made to sit under everything you use.
settings.body: Shot across real desks — wood, white, warm light. The mat does the same job in all of them: it draws the working area and lets the rest of the setup settle.

settings.heading: We make one thing, and we make it the centre of the desk.
settings.body: DeskKart is a workspace brand built around a simple idea: the surface you work on deserves as much thought as the hardware you put on it. We started with the desk mat because it is the piece that touches everything else — and the one most setups are missing.

settings.question: What exactly is a desk mat?
settings.answer: A single large surface that sits on your desk and holds your keyboard, mouse and everyday items. It defines the working area, softens the surface under your hardware and protects the desk underneath.

settings.question: How do I choose the right one for my desk?
settings.answer: Measure the span your keyboard and mouse occupy when you work comfortably, then leave room on either side. Confirmed sizes for this mat are listed in the specification section once finalised.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Orders are dispatched from Lahore. Delivery times and charges are shown at checkout and set by the store's shipping policy.

settings.question: Can I pay cash on delivery?
settings.answer: The payment methods available to you are shown at checkout once the store's payment providers are active.

settings.question: What if it is not right for my desk?
settings.answer: Returns are handled under the store's refund policy. Contact us with your order number and we will take it from there.

settings.question: How do I keep it clean?
settings.answer: A damp cloth handles everyday dust and marks. Let it dry flat before putting hardware back on top.

settings.heading: Finish the desk.
settings.body: One mat, one surface, one less thing to think about.
